out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CORRECTED

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the several ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed, in some of the reach- in refrigerators.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unmarked spray bottles containing toxic cleaning chemical solution without labels, to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CORRECTED.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Food handling employees were observed wearing watches and bracelets
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the refuse container outside the facility.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean.

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse containers were uncovered.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. RSVP CO INC (Inspection Date: 08/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the walls and ceiling inside one of the walk-in refrigerators in the main kitchen, in need of cleaning. These walls were observed to be dusty.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the walk-in freezer is not maintained in good repair. These walls Herat element on the door does not appear to be operating and the motor unit leaks causing ice build-up.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The permit was observed posted in the kitchen office.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 160F. The thermostat read 158F.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 160F.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: guacamole., yogurt, deli meats, etc.,
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Food (sauces, soups) not loosely covered, during the cooling precess, inside the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.,

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Unmarked containers holding spices and other food that are not easily identifiable, were not observed labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Hot Water Sanitizing, Pressure Device
violations.observation: The pressure gauge for the high temperature final rinse warewash machine is operating properly. The dial on the gauge is broken.
violations.corrective_action: Warewashing machines that provide a fresh hot water sanitizing rinse shall be equipped with a pressure gauge or similar device such as a transducer that measures and displays the water pressure in the supply line immediately before entering the warewashing machine and if the flow pressure measuring device is upstream of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse control valve, the device shall be mounted in a 6.4 millimeter or one-fourth Iron Pipe Size (IPS) valve.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The FLOOR DRAIN UNDER THE 3-COMPARTMENT SINK, is slow to drain, and causing overflow.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Unclogged the drain for proper flow.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the some ceiling tiles are not in place. Some of the ceilings tiles at the coo-line, are very stained and need. Cleaning, repainting, or to replace them.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. RSVP CO INC (Inspection Date: 02/27/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lighting Intensity, 50 Foot Candles Minimum
violations.observation: Observed that inadequate lighting was provided in the food preparation areas.
violations.corrective_action: Increase the lighting to provide a minimum of 50 foot candles in all food preparation areas.

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed the protective light coverings are missing on some of the ceiling light fixtures.
violations.corrective_action: Replace the missing light covers to protect y food and food contact surfaces from possible contamination.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons were not stored in white rye flour and wheat flour type containers with the handles up.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. PIC removed and cleaned scoops.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: no hot water at prep sink next to the ice machine, facet of 3 vat sink is leaking, over flow drain is missing at 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC contacted technician during inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the wall in the dry storage, the wall next to 3 compartment sink, ceiling next to dish machine, is not maintained in good repair, ceiling next to the coffee dispenser.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC contacted technician during inspection.
